item1.justification: Although the §103 stage lists Graham factors, the §102 and §103 analyses of dependent claims 3–6 address only their added features rather than every limitation inherited from allowable independent claim 1, contrary to the all-elements/claim-as-a-whole frameworks.

item2.justification: The conclusions consistently identify specific claim features and corresponding disclosures in US-2013338722-A1, such as the secondary drive formation, tapered threads, full-length threading, and proximal head.

item3.justification: The trace treats independent claim 1 as patentable while rejecting dependent claims 3–6 solely because their additional limitations are disclosed or conventional, without explaining how all inherited limitations of claim 1 are rendered obvious.

item4.justification: The low-strictness examiner resolves ambiguous disclosures in favor of patentability and, consistent with the high combination threshold, rejects only claims supported by asserted explicit disclosures and conventionality rationales.

item5.justification: The final amend-suggested decision follows the stage-level allowance of claims 1–2 and 7–11 and rejection of claims 3–6, with an express summary of the cited technical distinctions and rejection grounds.
